## MC Hoster 2.1.0

### New plugins (tick them in tab 5)
- **Dark Fishing**: fishing catches custom fish with a rarity (Common to Mythic), weight, length and a price, shown on screen when you catch them ("You've discovered … for the first time!"), and sold with `/sell`. Shiny, Giant, Molten and Void-Touched fish are worth more. You can also catch **money vouchers**, **shard vouchers** (right-click to use), **crate keys** and fishing books: put **Lava Line** on your rod to fish in **lava**, **Void Line** to fish in **the void**, each with their own fish. `/fish` shows your collection (water, lava, void). Ops: `/fish give <player> lava|void|money <amount>|shards <amount>`.
- **Dark NPCs**: `/npc create` → type a player (the NPC gets their skin) → pick the command in a menu (RTP, Shop, AH, Hubs, Crates, Store... or type your own, also as the console) → name it. It stands where you are with its name and **CLICK ME** above it, looks at players, and clicking it runs the command. Sneak + right-click it (or `/npc edit`) to change it, `/npc delete` to remove it. Real player-shaped NPCs on Minecraft 1.21.9+, an armor stand with the player's head on older versions.
- **No Enchant Limits**: `/enchant` with any enchantment on any item at any level up to 255 (the most Minecraft can save): `/enchant wind_burst 64` on the mace you hold, or `/enchant <player> sharpness 100`. If an enchantment does nothing on that item, it's still added and you get a warning.

### Dark Ranks: /store
- `/store` shows the ranks people can buy with real money on your web store (Tebex, your website…). GUI mode (default): an enchanted totem **Paid Ranks** that opens the paid ranks with their price and perks; clicking one sends the store link. Text mode: the link in chat. Ops change everything with `/store edit` (ranks, prices, perks, icons, the link, the mode), or `/store link <url>` and `/store mode gui|text`.

### MC Hoster
- **New tab 7. Experimental**: commands that run every time the server starts, as soon as it's ready (so every plugin's commands work), one per line. "Run them now" runs them on the running server.
- **A warning in tab 5**: some plugins and mods can be malicious and make themselves operator. Use official sites.
- **Dark Shop**: `/sell` pays each Dark Fishing fish its own price, and more items can be sold (fish, sea and nether loot, trial items...).
